svg.metadata: {"id": "s106", "name": "秋山枫林·石径人家", "cat": "季节专题", "tags": ["语文", "古诗", "秋天", "秋游", "山水"], "desc": "层林尽染的秋山：远处青紫群山、白云缭绕的半山腰有几户白墙灰瓦人家，一条石阶小路弯弯曲曲伸向山上，满山枫红，落叶飘飞。无任何标牌，适合古诗《山行》与秋游。", "stand": {"ground_y": 930, "x": [460, 1460]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": 0}, {"name": "mountains", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": 0.15}, {"name": "houses", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": 0.2}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.35, "loop": "drift", "depth": 0.08}, {"name": "forest_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": 0.3}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": 0.6}, {"name": "trees_mid", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": 0.62}, {"name": "near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.9, "loop": null, "depth": 1}, {"name": "falling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "fall", "depth": 0.9}], "palette": {"sky1": "#9CCBEA", "sky2": "#FFE3C4", "sun": "#FFF0C4", "mtn": "#C7B5D3", "mtn2": "#AF97C1", "far": "#E8743A", "far2": "#D9542B", "ground": "#E3B07A", "ground2": "#C98F5A", "path": "#EADFCB", "path2": "#BFAF96", "t1": "#F6B930", "t2": "#FFD95A", "t3": "#E07A22", "t4": "#D9542B", "trunk": "#7A4E33", "trunk2": "#5E3A26", "wall": "#F6EEE0", "wall2": "#DCCDB6", "roof": "#5B5F6E", "roof2": "#454856", "door": "#8A5536", "grass": "#B9743A"}}
